provenance.measurements: locally executed behavioral probes with public synthetic inputs

acceptanceScope: Partial component mechanism evidence; not completion of all acceptance requirements or a standalone-model comparison.

components.boundary: Bounded scheduling, cancellation, authority ceilings and ephemeral fixture execution; partial evidence only, without crash recovery, idempotency or real external effects.
Header reconstruction, mandatory-source preservation, lexical retrieval, bridge limits and overflow; not model-driven compaction or all repeated-cycle scenarios.
Exact immutable source text and stable source selection; no ownership, byte-range editing or projection deletion API in this supplied module.
Requirement coverage, DAG cycles, authority ceilings and lifecycle gates; lexical anchor ordering and adversarial delimiter parsing are not tested.
Dependency-gated proposals, exact supported fixture output and unsupported-output failure; no randomized hosted generation or complete billed-call accounting.
Section binding, exact/locked protection, stale revisions and independent reviewer identity checks; no general semantic validator or native dialect equivalence proof.

Caller-attested measurement validation, eligible selection, missing metrics, deterministic ties, marginal gain and future-only feedback. These vectors do not establish actual expert quality or a calibrated adaptive policy.
Capability denial, envelope attenuation, disabled effects and cancellation; no operating-system confinement, human authentication, live mutation or network execution.
Exact source receipts, duplicated content, disputed and unresolved states; exact-text matching does not establish factual truth or general semantic entailment.
Atomic overflow, frozen same-frame reads, support deduplication and unresolved collapse gates; synthetic state-machine evidence, without native neural execution or publisher authentication.
Complete fixture usage arithmetic, unknown values and dependency-consistent interval calculations; no actual serial-model baseline, provider billing or inference latency measurement.
Local capsule replay and fixture run-bundle tamper rejection; no durable committed-run replay, hosted regeneration or external side effects.
